R01.title: Shell / command execution tool
R01.advice: Remove the tool, or run it in a sandbox with an allow-list of commands and no shell metacharacters.

R02.title: Destructive tool with no confirmation parameter
R02.advice: Add a required confirmation parameter (for example 'confirm': true) and log every destructive call.

R03.title: File-write tool with no declared allowed paths
R03.advice: Declare 'allowed_paths' on the server and reject writes outside them.

R04.title: Network egress / open-world tool
R04.advice: Restrict destinations to an allow-list of hosts and log every outbound request.

R05.title: Secret / credential access
R05.advice: Never expose environment variables, tokens or passwords through tools or resources; use a secrets manager.

R06.title: Remote transport with no authentication
R06.advice: Add authentication (API key or OAuth) before exposing the server over SSE or streamable HTTP.

R07.title: Tool with no safety annotations
R07.advice: Set the MCP annotations (readOnlyHint, destructiveHint, idempotentHint, openWorldHint) on every tool.

R08.title: Sensitive resource exposed
R08.advice: Remove credentials, config files and environment data from the resource list.

R09.title: Unscoped file read (arbitrary path, no allowed paths)
R09.advice: Declare 'allowed_paths' and reject reads outside them.

R10.title: Missing server metadata
R10.advice: Give the server a name, version and description so it can be identified and reviewed.
